name: project-flow
description: A disciplined requirements-to-review workflow for software projects: clarify, specify, ticket, implement, and review without scope drift.

interface.longDescription: Five reusable skills for turning product decisions into implementation-ready specifications, small tickets, bounded code changes, and evidence-based code reviews.
defaultPrompt: Use grill-with-docs to clarify these requirements before implementation.
Use to-spec to turn the approved requirement into an implementation-ready spec.
Use to-tickets to split this spec into small verifiable tickets.
Use implement to execute one approved ticket without scope expansion.
Use code-review to review the diff against the ticket and governing spec.
